mechanism: Keep a retreating subject facing an advancing hazard while a camera moves backward at matched speed; progressively reduce corridor clearance along the shared axis, preserve one visible protective threshold behind the subject, then complete one crossing and boundary closure.

invariants.rule: Establish a subject facing the threat while moving backward toward a visible route.
invariants.ablation_failure: Turning away removes simultaneous face-and-threat proof.

invariants.rule: Advance the environmental hazard along the same corridor axis as the retreat.
invariants.ablation_failure: Random off-axis debris becomes generic chaos.

invariants.rule: Reduce visible clearance in at least two stages without changing subject identity or route.
invariants.ablation_failure: One sudden blast provides no progressive pressure.

invariants.rule: Keep one protective threshold readable behind the subject before the final crossing.
invariants.purpose: Gives the retreat a clear actionable destination.
invariants.ablation_failure: A surprise exit appears as an unearned rescue.

invariants.rule: Use one terminal crossing and visible boundary separation from the hazard.
invariants.purpose: Resolves the corridor problem without claiming unseen survival.
invariants.ablation_failure: Cutting before the boundary leaves the payoff unproved.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the exact hatch and collapse choreography
